limits: One fixed guidance3 task and named stream; no CFG, source-correlation, angle, amplitude, seed or horizon scan.
The qualified unguided rotated task did not consistently reproduce the original particle gap; this new mechanism is a separate hypothesis and does not retrofit that result.
The two-site width16/rank2 host is a small BF16 surrogate, not the full Supra transformer, caption/null-caption encoder, attention, VAE or spatial/token distribution.
The unconditional vector is a deterministic mean of six unchanged synthetic source vectors. Supra uses its real null-caption sequence and mask; that transfer distinction remains.

Conditional activations stay bitwise exact; replacement of their source contribution is FP32 arithmetic. It shares the same mathematical latent/time input, rather than reconstructing separately rounded original latent tensors.
Host activations physically use2B while native route logits/mixes use[B,2,T,N/Z]. Evidence remainsB contexts and row proposals rerun the entire guided model.
Each half retains held BF16 branch boundaries. The new final combination isFP32; this changes final output support/transient shapes alongside the guidance law and is reported rather than hidden.
The teacher remains exactly ordinary-LoRA reachable and inherits fixedrho=.0276253667, a severe rank2/width16 acquisition regime; neither feature isolates every full-Supra difficulty.
Guided targets/base/whitening and newly trained critic heads change together. Absolute game scores, output RMSE or gap percentages cannot be subtracted from the unguided task as causal effect sizes.
Native owner-dependent floors, noise eligibility, LR/controller responses can differ between ordinary and routed configurations. Retain all four heads, signed scores and actual control records.
Output metrics remain offline diagnostics and never enter the optimizer, structural decisions/guards, stopping, or head/checkpoint selection.
Qualification is this standalone CPU task only, with no Forge/default/full-Supra promotion credit.
Exact held code-object SHA binds the current Python interpreter and absolute checkout filename; source bytes, callbacks, runtime, archives and native package identity are also explicitly bound.

guided_pair.unconditional_source: fixed mean of the unchanged six parent source vectors
guided_pair.conditional_source: exact parent six source vectors and frozen source projection; no correlation change

guided_pair.routed_logits_and_codes: Chunk physical 2B then stack [B,2,T,N] logits and [B,2,T,Z] codes; inverse is cat(code[:,0],code[:,1]) along batch, not reshape.
guided_pair.dv12: Public native RoutedRows perturbs flattened mixed codes independently for each half/token/site; no custom optimizer/noise law.
guided_pair.coupling: Each candidate reruns both shared-parameter sites and both halves, including second-site keys from candidate-dependent first-site outputs, then the final guided combination.
guided_pair.effective_sample_size: B=4 contextual observations; mean across halves/tokens then equally across sites. Neither 2B, tokens nor sites inflate evidence.
guided_pair.precision: Held BF16 frozen projections and BF16 adapter boundaries per half; final guided combination is FP32 in Supra arithmetic order u+3*(c-u), mathematically3c-2u; no final BF16 recast.
